blocks.value: Assignment operators assign a value to a variable. The left operand receives the value of the expression on the right. The compound forms (+=, -=, etc.) combine an operation with assignment in one step.

int score;
score = 32;   // score is 32
score += 2;   // score is 34  (same as score = score + 2)
score -= 3;   // score is 31
score *= 2;   // score is 62
score /= 2;   // score is 31
score %= 2;   // score is 1
score++;      // score is 2
score--;      // score is 1
